name: ovhcloud-ai-endpoints-copilot
displayName: OVHcloud AI Endpoints for Copilot Chat
description: Use OVHcloud AI Endpoints models (Llama, Mistral, Qwen, DeepSeek, gpt-oss...) in GitHub Copilot Chat. European sovereign AI, by EUSovereignAI. Unofficial community provider.

walkthroughs.title: Set up OVHcloud AI Endpoints for Copilot Chat
walkthroughs.description: Three steps: get an OVHcloud token, store it in VS Code, pick a model in Copilot Chat.

steps.title: 1. Get your OVHcloud AI Endpoints token
steps.description:
Create an API key in the OVHcloud control panel: Public Cloud > your project > AI Endpoints > API keys.
[Open OVHcloud control panel](https://www.ovh.com/manager/#/public-cloud/)

steps.title: 2. Store the token in VS Code
steps.description:
The token is saved in VS Code secret storage (macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, libsecret on Linux). It never goes into settings.json.
[Set API token](command:ovhAiEndpoints.setToken)

steps.title: 3. Check the connection
steps.description:
List the models your token gives access to.
[Test connection](command:ovhAiEndpoints.testConnection)

steps.title: 4. Pick a model in Copilot Chat
steps.description:
Open Copilot Chat, click the model name, choose Manage Models..., then OVHcloud AI Endpoints, and tick the models you want in the picker.
[Open Copilot Chat](command:workbench.action.chat.open)

ovhAiEndpoints.baseUrl.markdownDescription: OpenAI-compatible base URL. Default is the OVHcloud AI Endpoints unified route. You can point it to another compatible router (e.g. `https://router.huggingface.co/v1`).

ovhAiEndpoints.defaultMaxInputTokens.description: Context window (input tokens) reported to Copilot when a model does not advertise one.

ovhAiEndpoints.defaultMaxOutputTokens.description: Max output tokens reported to Copilot when a model does not advertise one.

ovhAiEndpoints.modelOverrides.markdownDescription: Per-model overrides keyed by model id. Example: `{ "Meta-Llama-3_3-70B-Instruct": { "maxInputTokens": 131072, "toolCalling": true, "imageInput": false, "hidden": false } }`

ovhAiEndpoints.hideModelPatterns.description: Model ids containing any of these substrings (case-insensitive) are not listed as chat models.
